messages:
Camille P: quick pulse  noticed this week's KPI board shows a sudden uptick in launch-post conversions overnight, but CRM-accepted leads didn't budge. can analytics sanity-check before we blow this up to ops/executives? :wave:

Ari V: on it. quick look: sessions + form completions rose ~30% on 2024-06-08, but accepted leads flat. could be a telemetry sample change or a routing tweak.

Noah D: FYI we ran a small sample-rate test for the front-end beacon on 2024-06-08 02:10 UTC (20% -> 70%) to debug missing impressions; reverted at 02:45 UTC. streaming widget used raw counts.

Rhea S: thanks  i'll add a sample-normalized series and annotate the KPI board so execs don't see a noisy spike. also will ask growth to split by subject-line used in the launch-post.

Ari V: SQL i'll run for normalization:
```sql
SELECT date, SUM(unique_users)/NULLIF(avg_sample_rate,0) AS normalized_users
FROM daily_ingest
WHERE date BETWEEN '2024-06-05' AND '2024-06-10'
GROUP BY date;
```

Noah D: kicked a backfill to fix streaming aggregates and apply normalization. job: `airflow trigger_dag streaming_recalc --conf '{"start":"2024-06-05","end":"2024-06-10"}'`. ETA ~40m.

Rhea S: growth note: variant-B subject line peaked on open rate during that window; will attach the variant cohort to the campaign doc so analytics can split messaging-driven lift vs telemetry artifact.

dashbot: dashboard annotated: "sample-rate test on 2024-06-08; normalized series added" (annotation id: a-20240608-sample). public KPI board: https://dash.redwood.com/r/kpi-weekly

Camille P: awesome. once backfill is complete, please post a short 2-line summary with corrected MQLs and a note about messaging vs sampling before we surface in the exec digest. thanks! :thumbsup:
